name: Buer Within: AI Growth Coach
subtitle: Your story. Your next step.
promotionalText: Build a profile that grows with you. Reflect across four life domains, bring your own experiences to AI conversations, and turn insight into an action you can review.
description:
Your story. Your next step.

Buer Within is your personal AI growth coach. Explore how you see yourself, work through your present situation and build a record of the actions and experiences that shape your life.

1. GET TO KNOW YOURSELF
Start with birth details to create a Human Design-based reading on your device. Use it as an interpretive lens, then compare its ideas with your own experience. It does not define your abilities or determine your future.

2. FIND A DIRECTION — OR COME BACK LATER
An optional HUMAN 3.0-inspired reflection explores mind, body, connection and meaning, and vocation. Answer 12 starting questions at your own pace. Pause, resume or revise your answers, then request an AI guide with observations, a small next step and longer-term review points.

3. BRING YOUR STORY
Add turning points, experiences, goals, preferences and constraints over time. Paste text or import TXT and Markdown. Edit and delete entries, and choose which ones AI may reference. When you enable profile context in chat, a relevant subset of permitted information accompanies your question.

TURN INSIGHT INTO PRACTICE
Choose an action, set a review date and describe what progress would look like. Record what happened and what you would change. Your growth profile stays on your device and can be exported or cleared.

YOU CONTROL WHAT YOU SHARE
AI requests go to our server and DeepSeek after consent. Birth details are not automatically attached. Your selected reflection answers and stories may include personal information you have written. No automatic import of other phone data and no cross-device profile sync.

FREE AND OPTIONAL PLUS MEMBERSHIP
Receive 3 completed AI replies per day, resetting at 00:00 UTC. A completed AI action guide counts as one reply. Failed requests do not use your allowance. Local reflections, stories, readings and action records require no subscription. Optional monthly or annual Plus membership removes the daily AI reply limit; reasonable anti-abuse limits still apply.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in Apple subscription settings.

Human Design readings are interpretive, not scientific assessments. The four-domain reflection is inspired by Dan Koe's HUMAN 3.0 framework; it is not an official or validated psychological assessment. AI can make mistakes. Buer Within supports reflection, not medical, psychological, legal or financial advice. You remain the decision-maker.
